subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should built-in compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns with missing results, matching the prompt-send sanitizer, instead of synthesizing a placeholder result?
rationale: Both choices produce provider-valid history, but they encode different session-state semantics: dropping avoids fabricated tool output while losing partial aborted-turn context.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR after normal exact-head review, treating aborted tool-call turns as incomplete context that should not reach summarization.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask for a revised PR that preserves aborted turns by inserting a clearly synthetic result and proving strict-provider acceptance.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Keep this PR unmerged while maintainers define a richer interrupted-tool recovery contract across compaction, replay, and durable repair.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after normal exact-head review, treating aborted tool-call turns as incomplete context that should not reach summarization.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice centers on the session transcript repair contract that steipete introduced and has repeatedly maintained.
